Prepare a website conversation brief
04 / Before we begin

Website project
questions, answered.

How much will my website cost?

Pricing depends on the number of pages, features, content and ongoing support. Tell us your requirements and budget range so the proposal can define a suitable scope. Domain, hosting and software costs should be clarified separately.

What should I prepare?

Bring your business description, service list, contact details, logo and photographs you have permission to use. Include examples of websites you like and any content you still need help preparing.

Can you improve my existing website?

We can start by reviewing your current website. The next step depends on its platform, access and condition: focused improvements, migration or a rebuild.

How long will the project take?

The schedule depends on scope, content readiness and review time. Share your target launch date so milestones and responsibilities can be agreed before the project starts.

Will my website appear first on Google?

No ranking or indexing position is guaranteed. Meaningful titles, clear headings, crawlable pages, internal links and mobile layouts provide a useful foundation. Search visibility also depends on competition, content and continued work.

What about hosting and ongoing support?

Discuss whether you need domain configuration, hosting or maintenance. Confirm ownership, included support, renewal costs and responsibilities in the proposal.
